title: KAABIL *Station*
lede: For community centres, schools, NGOs and skill centres. Anyone can walk up, talk to Saathi, build a skill profile and print a parchi — no smartphone needed.
pickStationLede: Select where this device is placed. Slips printed here will carry the station name.
noStations: No active stations yet. An administrator can add one.
assistedHint: Slips will be marked “Assisted by Station helper”.
privacy: Each visitor's session is wiped automatically after a period of no activity, so the next person starts fresh.

kiosk.helperPanelBody: Please wait here. A centre worker will come to help you shortly.
kiosk.helperPilot: Pilot: please also wave to the desk — automatic alerts are still being set up.
kiosk.endConfirmBody: Your details will be removed from this machine. Print your parchi first if you need it.
kiosk.ended: Session ended. Ready for the next person.
kiosk.pinHint: Enter the 4-digit helper PIN to exit Station mode.
kiosk.idleBody: For your privacy, this session will reset in {seconds} seconds.
